meta.title: Add database caching for folder scan results to improve performance
meta.body_summary: Implement SQLite database caching for folder scan results in AppDataCleaner so subsequent scans load from cache, claiming ~10-100x speed improvement over full filesystem scans.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added SQLite caching; maintainer fixed scan logic and merged with no review comments, claiming 10-100x speedup without benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 605 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium feature by absolute volume, adding a new database module and caching logic in a small Rust app. The quick merge after a maintainer fix aligns with a low-risk performance improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer committed a fix titled '修正数据库读取、扫描逻辑' (fix database reading, scanning logic) after Copilot's implementation, indicating the initial logic needed correction.
review_details.performance_claim: ~10-100x faster loading from cache vs filesystem scan.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully integrated a new SQLite database module and caching logic into the existing scanner; the need for a maintainer fix suggests the initial logic had minor flaws, but the change was otherwise within Copilot's technical reach.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer TC999 reviewed the code and committed a fix for database reading and scanning logic without leaving review comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body claims a 10-100x speedup but provides no benchmark numbers or before/after measurements; no profiler or CI performance test mentioned.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After Copilot's commits, maintainer added a commit '修正数据库读取、扫描逻辑' before merging, fixing issues in the same PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added src/database.rs with SQLite schema and CRUD operations for caching folder scan results; modified scanner.rs to check cache first and update only on changes; updated clear_tab.rs for status messages; added rusqlite to Cargo.toml and .gitignore.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Minor changes: main.rs adds module import, Cargo.toml adds dependency, .gitignore ignores database file.
change_trajectory: Added database module, updated scanner and UI with caching logic.
Completed implementation with user feedback (presumably from maintainer) adding more database and scanner logic.
Maintainer committed a fix for database reading and scanning logic before merging.
